role: transit authority with prior experience including noise restrictions in construction contract specifications
stance_basis: cited as a precedent example of successful noise restriction practice, no position on the project expressed
summary: The New York City Transit Authority is referenced as a prior example of an agency that has successfully included noise restrictions in construction contract specifications. The document uses this experience as justification and precedent for adopting similar noise limit specifications in the NFTA Metro Corridor construction contracts. The NYCTA does not express any position on the project itself.
complaint_summary: The New York City Transit Authority is cited as having included noise restrictions in construction contract specifications, with the experience showing considerable success in reducing construction noise, serving as a model for the NFTA Metro Corridor project.
summary_quote: Recent projects of the New York City Transit Authority and the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority have included noise restrictions in the contract specifications.
